title: LLMs as Validators for Cross-Chain Bridges: Evaluating Source-Level and Transaction-Level Attack Detection on Solana
abstract: arXiv:2611.21777v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-chain bridges have suffered substantial asset losses due to vulnerabilities in their on-chain programs. On Solana, missing validation checks can enable exploits even when the underlying blockchain operates correctly. The ability of large language models (LLMs) to diagnose these flaws from source code or transaction records, rather than merely raise alarms, remains insufficiently understood. We implement a native Rust lock-and-mint bridge on a local Solana validator with four exploitable variants: two model flaws from the Cashio and Wormhole incidents, while the other two represent vulnerability classes documented in Solana security audits. Paired vulnerable and secure programs, together with successful attacks, benign sessions, and blocked attempts, allow us to distinguish correct diagnoses from unsupported alarms. translated_title: 大语言模型作为跨链桥的验证器：评估Solana上源代码级与交易级的攻击检测
translated_abstract: 跨链桥因链上程序的漏洞而遭受了巨大的资产损失。在Solana上，即使底层区块链本身运行正确，缺失的验证检查也可能使漏洞被利用。大语言模型（LLM）能否从源代码或交易记录中诊断出这些缺陷，而不仅仅是发出警报，这一能力至今仍未被充分理解。我们在本地Solana验证节点上实现了一个原生Rust的锁币-铸币桥，其中包含四个可利用的变体：两个模拟了Cashio和Wormhole事件中的缺陷，另外两个则代表了Solana安全审计中记录的漏洞类别。通过将易受攻击的程序与安全程序成对组合，并结合成功的攻击、良性会话和被阻止的尝试，我们能够区分正确的诊断与缺乏依据的警报。我们在16,800个响应上评估了五个开源权重模型的六种配置，比较了包含与不包含……的源代码输入（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含四种可利用变体的Solana本地锁币-铸币桥测试平台，基于16,800个响应评估了五个开源大语言模型在源代码级和交易级上区分真实漏洞诊断与无依据警报的攻击检测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper builds a local Solana lock-and-mint bridge testbed with four exploitable variants and evaluates five open-weight LLMs across 16,800 responses to assess their ability to distinguish correct vulnerability diagnoses from unsupported alarms at both the source-code and transaction levels.
